The Zenith 4 Gas Barbecue Grill has 4 independently controlled burners which means you can adjust each food area for optimised cooking of different types of food. The optional Griddle plate is also Ideal for cooking breakfast foods such as pancakes, sausages, bacon, eggs, hash browns and french toast.

overview: Barbecuing is one of the best ways to cook for large parties during the summer months. The Fir Tree Zenith 5 Gas BBQ is the larger sibling of the Zenith 4 and offers commercial-grade performance in a compact size that allows for both home and commercial use.

The Zenith 5 Stainless Steel Gas Barbecue has a push button ignition making barbecue grilling easier than ever before. Wheeled for mobility and with just one push of the button, you can get the BBQ set up and have your grill heated and ready to cook in no time. Plus, its foldable design means you can store it away easily when not in use - taking up minimal space! Cleaning is also easy since it takes only five minutes after each use. And, the Zenith 5 model has plenty of room on its large grill surface so you can cook enough food for everyone to enjoy!

The Zenith 5 Gas Barbecue Grill has 5 independently controlled burners which means you can adjust each food area for optimized cooking of different types of food. The optional Griddle plate is also Ideal for cooking breakfast foods such as pancakes, sausages, bacon, eggs, hash browns and french toast.
